hook: One Swift library for REST, JSON-RPC and WebSockets.

beats.say: Harbor four point oh is an open-source networking library built for Swift six strict concurrency, using async and await with no callbacks.
You declare each request as a Sendable struct, and get typed results, an HTTP cache with ETags, and offline fallback.
It ships as three products: REST, JSON-RPC two point oh, and WebSocket, so you only link what you use.
